text: ok so no re-exporting the prop or anything like that. can we set the variants to be renamed, since painting # is going to cascade into i dont know which one im looking for very quickly
resolution: Confirmed no re-export is needed (skins ride the existing export — the palette and world read paints/ from the package on disk live), and built variant renaming: each PAINT VARIANTS row now has a pencil verb that opens an inline name field (Enter or the check commits, Esc cancels — the Outliner's rename idiom). renamePaintVariant rewrites only the label in paint_N.json: the id, the png/base.png/blob files, and any placed instances wearing prop:X#p<id> are untouched, and the skins cache invalidates so the world quick-menu chips show the new name immediately. Editor cart bundles clean; hot reload delivers it.
